title: CI red on develop: Ruff fails on worker-image/src/tts (fish, higgs, qwen)
description: The quality workflow (ci.yml) has been failing on develop for at least the last three pushes (cbf1d9b, a468d2f, 4d1e5e7) with 78 Ruff errors in worker-image/src/tts/fish.py, higgs.py, and qwen.py: unsorted imports (I001), blind except Exception (BLE001), and an unsorted __all__ (RUF022). This blocks every PR's quality check from going green, independent of what the PR touches (surfaced while landing auritus-a9ffed / PR #62, which only touches site/ and was merged anyway since the failure predates it and there is no required-check branch protection blocking the merge). Most of the I001/RUF022 findings are auto-fixable with ruff check --fix src from worker-image/. The BLE001 findings in fish.py need a deliberate narrower exception type or a justified noqa, not a blanket fix.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Root cause: the lint code never changed; the linter did. The dev extra allowed any `ruff>=0.4.0`, CI installed 0.16.9, and 0.16's wider default rules (I001, BLE001, RUF022) fire 79 times across worker-image, cdk and features/steps. Locally, ruff 0.15.5 passes CI's exact command. Fix: pin `ruff==0.15.5` and `black==26.3.1` (PR #64). Adopting the 0.16 rules can be a deliberate later chore. This was blocking auritus-70d43b (PR #63), because the failed lint step skips pytest and behave.
